claims.statement: GIS states that covered foods must be notified electronically before first placement on the Polish market and lists required data including product identity, Polish labeling, and quantitative and qualitative composition.
GIS clarifies that it does not approve supplements and sale may begin on the notification date, while the entrepreneur must ensure and document legal compliance.

contrary_evidence: GIS notification is not an approval or acceptance decision.
Regulatory consultants and contract manufacturers may already provide launch-document services.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: embed the release pack at one contract manufacturer and let each client brand become a monitored account.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 600 monitored brands plus 1200 annual launches could produce over 4 million PLN yearly revenue; manufacturer-channel expansion could support founder net worth above 5 million PLN in years 6 to 9.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 15 hours weekly with food-law and toxicology expertise contracted per case.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 70% blended gross margin with qualified review sold separately.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: a manufacturer integration repays within six months if it yields eight launches and five monitored brands.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 1500 PLN per SKU launch plus 350 PLN monthly per brand for monitoring.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Hypothesis: new SKUs, formula substitutions, claims, packaging, and rule changes create repeat events.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A structured ingredient-claim-label-rule graph and private history of version defects and remediation
fingerprint.customer: Polish supplement contract manufacturers, regulatory firms, and multi-SKU brands
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Contract manufacturers, analytical labs, regulatory lawyers, packaging studios, and ecommerce agencies
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Per-SKU regulatory evidence software with recurring change monitoring
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The manufacturer or brand pays when a versioned launch pack receives an internal release decision
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A new or changed supplement is ready for production or listing and its notification and evidence must align

founder_fit: Supplements and proactive health align with the founder's domain interest.
Structured formula and claim analysis use data-science skills.
Contract-manufacturer distribution avoids an influencer-led go-to-market.
risks: A false pass could expose consumers and create food-law liability.
AI-generated claim review must never replace qualified legal or safety review.
Contract manufacturers could build the feature internally.

structure.control_point: Manufacturer or brand release record before production batch or ecommerce listing
structure.critical_dependency: Accurate ingredient and claim rules plus trusted handling of proprietary formulas

thesis: A Polish supplement release engine could reconcile quantitative formula, ingredient status, Polish label, claims, testing evidence, notifier identity, and GIS receipt before a contract manufacturer releases a production batch or an ecommerce listing. It would explicitly record that notification is not approval and make the brand's own compliance decision auditable.
title: Supplement Launch Proof for Polish Contract Manufacturers
uncertainties: The rate of label, claim, and formula defects caught after launch is unknown.
Brands may resist sharing commercially sensitive quantitative formulas.
The 45000 PLN capital figure and all commercial numbers below are hypotheses.
